title: Hacker House Medellín (maud web)
description: The server-rendered maud + HTMX front end. Server-rendered routes carry `client: false`: they belong in the map so the sync gate holds them to the source, but there is no JSON call to generate. The items this server renders are its own in-memory `Item` list (title + detail); they are not the reservations hhm-api serves.

Health.doc: Current JSON liveness response from hhm-web-server.

NewItem.doc: The urlencoded body of the HTMX create form. Both fields are required: the Rust struct has no defaults, and both inputs carry the HTML `required` attribute.

Readiness.doc: Current process/configuration readiness response from hhm-web-server.

AuthStartForm.doc: URL-encoded secure-entry form; Rust uses deny_unknown_fields.

turnstile_response.doc: Rust field serialized from form key `cf-turnstile-response`; Cloudflare Turnstile proof verified server-side.

home.summary: Server-rendered dashboard (maud) with the HTMX create form.

healthz.summary: Liveness plus which optional backends are configured.

list_reservations_partial.summary: The reservation list as an HTML fragment, swapped into #items by HTMX.

create_reservation_partial.summary: Append an item from the browser form and re-render the list fragment. Returns HTML, not JSON.

reservation_events.summary: Websocket upgrade. Frames are the plain-text string `created:<uuid>`, not JSON; the page uses them only as a hint to re-fetch the list fragment.

join_individual.summary: Render secure individual-entry page and mint a short-lived CSRF cookie.

join_organization.summary: Render secure organization-entry page and mint a short-lived CSRF cookie.

auth_start.summary: Verify exact origin, CSRF and Turnstile before redirecting into Shared Auth.

onboarding_individual.summary: Authenticated individual onboarding shell backed by server-side Shared Auth session/delegation.

onboarding_organization.summary: Authenticated organization onboarding shell backed by server-side Shared Auth session/delegation.

chat_events.summary: Authenticated websocket alias for realtime reservation/chat refresh events.
